title: Manual Runner live-feed test
objective: Create a small typed sensor dependency chain whose three isolated File Jobs make concurrent Runner progress easy to inspect.
requirements: SensorReading records expose label, value, unit, and featured fields with the exact planned types.
formatSensor emits the reading label, a colon, its numeric value, and its unit with stable spacing.
summarizeSensors preserves input order, includes only featured readings, reports the featured count, and returns No featured readings when none qualify.
SensorReading records expose label, value, unit, and featured fields with the exact planned types.

owns.name: SensorReading
owns.description: Describes one sensor reading and whether it belongs in the featured summary.
owns.declaration: export interface SensorReading { label: string; value: number; unit: string; featured: boolean; }

context.purpose: Defines the sensor vocabulary and summary behavior.

skills.name: Minimal sensor contract
skills.content: Export exactly the planned SensorReading interface. Keep every property required and add no runtime behavior or extra exports.

constraints: Do not add declarations beyond SensorReading.

files.task: Format one sensor reading with stable punctuation and spacing.
requirements: formatSensor emits the reading label, a colon, its numeric value, and its unit with stable spacing.

owns.name: formatSensor
owns.description: Formats one sensor label, numeric value, and unit for display.

context.purpose: Defines the exact sensor label behavior.

skills.name: NodeNext sensor formatter
skills.content: Use an import type for SensorReading and the exact NodeNext-relative module specifier supplied in the Agent Input. Return the label, colon, value, and unit without mutating the reading.

files.task: Compose the featured sensor summary from the shared formatter.
requirements: summarizeSensors preserves input order, includes only featured readings, reports the featured count, and returns No featured readings when none qualify.

owns.name: summarizeSensors
owns.description: Builds the ordered human-readable summary of featured sensor readings.
owns.declaration: export function summarizeSensors(readings: readonly SensorReading[]): string;

context.purpose: Defines filtering, ordering, header, and empty behavior.

skills.name: Stable sensor summary
skills.content: Filter without sorting or mutating. For one featured reading use `1 featured reading`; otherwise use `{count} featured readings`. Put each formatted reading on its own following line. Return exactly `No featured readings` when the filtered list is empty.

constraints: Call formatSensor(reading) for each featured reading.
